title: net2 gate, round 7v: round 7's students with q vetoing the push
description: Round 7's gate3 students (exp-net2-r7-gate3-124) moved toward the mode rule's cooperative window by q, their belief in copies. At its gate (exp-net2-gate-r7-125) and at p thresholds 0.3 and 0.4 (exp-net2-gate-r7t03-126, exp-net2-gate-r7t04-127) none passed, and per link the losses came from yielding: with Cubic from the start, on links with buffers of 20 to 112 packets some seeds' receive share fell to 0.15 to 0.5 where the rule's was 0.39 to 0.87, losing 0.4 to 1.1 there, while on deeper buffers they gained 0.3 to 0.6 as the share rule does. The cooperative window yields to a buffer-filling flow, so taking Cubic for copies is costly. Their beliefs are classifiers trained by cross-entropy on their labels whatever the policy, so here the same six students are exported with q vetoing the push instead (experiments/gate_threshold_export.py --copies rule, PPOSpec gate3_copies): u = u_rule + p' (1 - q') (share - u_rule), with both thresholds at 0.5 as trained, fixed before this gate ran. Taking Cubic for copies then costs at most the push. Policies in release model-net2-r7v-cands. They run next to the fixed rule on net1 v5 (u = 0.25, release model-net1v5) and BBRv3 on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s, with campaign seed 21. The share rule at k = 0.5 and 1 on net1 v5 also runs, as a reference and not a candidate: it is what the teacher does wherever a stock TCP flow is active, so with the fixed rule it bounds what the student can reach. The rule is unchanged (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py): per link, the mean over a candidate's seeds of its log utility minus the rule's; the candidate kept has the highest five-family mean; the gate passes if it beats the rule in cubic-first-60 and in new-20's competition conditions, each with its 95% interval over links above 0, is at or above the rule on the five-family mean, and is not worse with copies beyond its interval. A candidate that passes runs once on the test links. Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$IN/m/net1v5.pt" --u0 0.25 --k 0.5 1; P=(--policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k1.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT"
